Package com.btcvelocity.api.bridge

Interface BridgeChannel

public interface BridgeChannel
Service for sending and receiving btc:bridge messages between the proxy and its backend servers.

The bridge channel uses the btc:bridge plugin-messaging identifier. Outgoing messages are encoded by BridgeCodec and forwarded to the target RegisteredServer. Incoming messages from a backend are decoded and dispatched to every registered BridgeMessageListener.
